question: Which failed programs share a drug target?
raw: Lines [1]–[13] are curated records supported by ChEMBL. Line [1] shows Elafibranor — RESOLVE-IT and Pemafibrate — PROMINENT share Peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor alpha. Lines [2]–[10] show pairwise combinations of Solanezumab, Crenezumab, Aducanumab, and Gantenerumab sharing Amyloid-beta precursor protein. Line [11] shows Epacadostat + pembrolizumab — ECHO-301/KEYNOTE-252 and Bempegaldesleukin + nivolumab — PIVOT IO-001 share Programmed cell death protein 1. Line [12] shows Durvalumab ± tremelimumab — MYSTIC and Tiragolumab + atezolizumab — SKYSCRAPER-01 share Programmed cell death 1 ligand 1. Line [13] shows Verubecestat — EPOCH / APECS and Lanabecestat — AMARANTH / DAYBREAK-ALZ share Beta-secretase 1. The lines do not show statistical significance, text-mined evidence, predicted interactions, or trial outcomes.
